detailZones.title: Gearmotor and reducer
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible electric motor, finned housing, terminal box, coupling, reducer and their mounting feet.

detailZones.title: Drive drum and yellow guard
detailZones.description: Follow the black drive drum, exposed shaft end, bearing support and perforated yellow safety guard.

detailZones.title: Main belt and transfer
detailZones.description: Explore the broad black belt run, its steel edge guides and the visible belt-to-roller transfer.

detailZones.title: Transfer roller bed
detailZones.description: Inspect the clearly separated steel rollers, roller ends, bed rails and transfer supports.

detailZones.title: Support frame and floor feet
detailZones.description: Trace the visible conveyor frame, cross-braces, support legs, floor plates and their fasteners.

detailZones.title: Junction box, safety stop and sensors
detailZones.description: Inspect the blank electrical enclosure, red emergency-stop control, sensor heads, mounts and cable runs.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts are distributed across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported equipment states were excluded.
